papers.title: Active Learning for Rapid Targeted Synthesis of Compositionally Complex Alloys
papers.abstract: The next generation of advanced materials is tending toward increasingly complex compositions. Synthesizing precise composition is time-consuming and becomes exponentially demanding with increasing compositional complexity. An experienced human operator does significantly better than a beginner but still struggles to consistently achieve precision when synthesis parameters are coupled. The time to optimize synthesis becomes a barrier to exploring scientifically and technologically exciting compositionally complex materials. This investigation demonstrates an Active Learning (AL) approach for optimizing physical vapor deposition synthesis of thin-film alloys with up to five principal elements. We compared AL based on Gaussian Process (GP) and Random Forest (RF) models. The best performing models were able to discover synthesis parameters for a target quinary alloy in 14 iterations. We also demonstrate the capability of these models to be used in transfer learning tasks. RF and GP models trained on lower dimensional systems (i.e. ternary, quarternary) show an immediate improvement in prediction accuracy compared to models trained only on quinary samples. Furthermore, samples that only share a few elements in common with the target composition can be used for model pre-training. We believe that such AL approaches can be widely adapted to significantly accelerate the exploration of compositionally complex materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用主动学习优化合金合成参数，与生物力学有限元代理模型方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA or surrogate modeling for biomechanics; focuses on materials synthesis optimization, not simulation efficiency or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速复杂合金成分的合成参数优化。
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程和随机森林的主动学习迭代优化合成参数。
summary_zh.result: 主动学习在14次迭代内找到目标五元合金的合成参数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验合成验证模型预测的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the optimization of synthesis parameters for compositionally complex alloys, which is time-consuming and exponentially demanding.
summary_en.method: An active learning approach using Gaussian Process and Random Forest models iteratively proposes synthesis parameters to minimize the number of experiments.
summary_en.result: The best models discovered synthesis parameters for a target quinary alloy in 14 iterations, and transfer learning improved prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through actual physical vapor deposition synthesis of thin-film alloys.

papers.title: Domain Adversarial Active Learning for Domain Generalization Classification
papers.abstract: Domain generalization models aim to learn cross-domain knowledge from source domain data, to improve performance on unknown target domains. Recent research has demonstrated that diverse and rich source domain samples can enhance domain generalization capability. This paper argues that the impact of each sample on the model's generalization ability varies. Despite its small scale, a high-quality dataset can still attain a certain level of generalization ability. Motivated by this, we propose a domain-adversarial active learning (DAAL) algorithm for classification tasks in domain generalization. First, we analyze that the objective of tasks is to maximize the inter-class distance within the same domain and minimize the intra-class distance across different domains. To achieve this objective, we design a domain adversarial selection method that prioritizes challenging samples. Second, we posit that even in a converged model, there are subsets of features that lack discriminatory power within each domain. We attempt to identify these feature subsets and optimize them by a constraint loss. We validate and analyze our DAAL algorithm on multiple domain generalization datasets, comparing it with various domain generalization algorithms and active learning algorithms. Our results demonstrate that the DAAL algorithm can achieve strong generalization ability with fewer data resources, thereby reducing data annotation costs in domain generalization tasks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究域泛化中的主动学习，与FEA代理模型或生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on domain generalization for classification tasks, with no application to surrogate modeling, finite element analysis, or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少域泛化任务中的数据标注成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出域对抗主动学习算法，选择困难样本并优化特征子集。
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据集上以较少数据达到强泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准域泛化数据集上对比多种算法。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce annotation cost in domain generalization by selecting the most informative samples.
summary_en.method: A domain-adversarial active learning algorithm that prioritizes challenging samples and optimizes non-discriminative feature subsets via a constraint loss.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves strong generalization performance with fewer data resources on multiple domain generalization benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard domain generalization datasets and compared against various domain generalization and active learning algorithms.

papers.title: A polynomial chaos approach for uncertainty quantification of Monte Carlo transport codes
papers.abstract: In this contribution, we discuss the construction of Polynomial Chaos surrogates for Monte Carlo radiation transport applications via non-intrusive spectral projection. This contribution focuses on improvements with respect to the approach that we previously introduced in previous work. We focus on understanding the impact of re-sampling cost on the algorithm performance and provide algorithm refinements, which allow to obtain unbiased estimators for the variance, estimate the PC variability due to limited samples, and adapt the expansion. An attenuation-only test case is provided to illustrate and discuss the results.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文的PC方法可用于生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化，但需调整至植入物设计场景。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on radiation transport, not biomedical FEA or implant mechanics, and lacks constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高蒙特卡洛输运代码中多项式混沌代理的效率和准确性。
summary_zh.method: 通过非侵入式谱投影构建PC代理，并改进重采样策略以获取无偏方差估计。
summary_zh.result: 算法改进实现了无偏方差估计和自适应展开，降低了重采样成本。
summary_zh.validation: 在衰减测试案例上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of Polynomial Chaos surrogates for Monte Carlo radiation transport codes by addressing resampling cost and estimator bias.
summary_en.method: Non-intrusive spectral projection is used to construct PC surrogates, with refinements to obtain unbiased variance estimators and adapt the expansion.
summary_en.result: The refinements yield unbiased variance estimates and adaptive expansion, reducing resampling cost.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on an attenuation-only test case.
